title: Hearty Crispy Polish Milk Tagine
description: A traditional Polish dish featuring crispy milk and hearty flavors, cooked in a ceramic tagine, onion and garlic free, perfect for a cold monsoon day.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large ceramic tagine, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced potatoes, sliced carrots, and diced celery, and cook until they start to brown.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
In a small bowl, mix the tomato paste with a little water to thin it out.
Add the tomato paste mixture to the tagine and stir to combine.
Pour in the milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
